DHT   |length | UN | LN | code length                                     | actual code


UN: upper nipple Tc table class combination of, (DC, AC) x (Luma, Chroma)
LN: lower nibble TH destination 
code length: L1, L2 ... L16, occurance of codes with lenght i

actual code: Sum(L1*1..L16*16) bits
